item.title: Moday 1.1.4
item.description:
Moday 1.1.4

  • 更简单：只剩「计划 / 今天 / 保底」。每天都是同一种日子，不用再先选今天是哪种。
  • ★ 是唯一的重量：给最重要的几件标 ★。状态不好时打开「保底」（工具栏开关，或菜单「日子 → 保底」⌘⌥B），只留 ★ 的任务，每件做到最低一步就算。
  • 去掉了日子类型、出现方式、核心、组合/轮换任务、训练入口和一周节奏页。已有任务和历史记录自动保留并转换，原来的「核心」变成 ★。
  • Simpler: just plan, today and floor. Every day is the same kind of day — no more picking a day type first.
  • ★ is the only weight: star the few things that matter most. On a low day turn on Floor (toolbar switch, or Day → Floor ⌘⌥B) to keep only the ★ tasks; the smallest step of each counts.
  • Day types, appearance modes, core, task groups/rotations, training and the weekly rhythm page are gone. Existing tasks and history are kept and converted automatically; former core tasks become ★.
